core_obligations: Beyond the retained modular direct-sum support, the author constructs promise Gap-Ort-of-Sum-Equal reductions, embeds multiple augmented-index levels into weighted stream frequencies and controls decoding error to obtain the L0 space lower bound. The integer-domain information bound and the original heavy-hitters-oracle reduction are retained. All original epsilon/k/N/T conditions and strict-turnstile promises remain verbatim; no bound is asserted outside the stated regime.
